dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: It sounds like you enjoyed having everyone there. I hope you managed to get some rest afterwards.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Eventually, yes. Clearing up took longer than expected. Next gathering, someone else can host. Anyway, thanks for keeping this appointment by phone. No travelling, no finding parking, much easier to fit around work.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You're welcome. We can cover the discussion here, and you can refer to your usual banking correspondence afterwards without having to make a separate visit.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That arrangement quite convenient. I keep the correspondence together, otherwise later must search through all my messages. I've put my notebook beside me, so no need to stop halfway and look for paper.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll move to the investment discussion now. To confirm, your objective is long-term capital growth through Asian equities, using money you do not need for near-term expenses.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Just let me put my mobile on silent. The office messages keep popping up. There, that's better; you've got my attention now.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Go ahead with the transaction as you just stated.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the instruction discussion. Is there anything about contacting me or arranging future calls that you would like to cover before we finish?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: For appointments, send me a message first, can? Sometimes I'm with staff and cannot pick up straight away. If we arrange it beforehand like today, I can find somewhere quiet. No need to keep calling while I'm in a meeting.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note your preference for arranging a suitable time by message. If you miss a call, you can contact me through the bank's usual channels when you're available.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Good, that saves the back and forth. Nothing else from me today, Rachel. I should get back to the office work before everyone starts looking for me.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian. Enjoy the rest of your day. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. Bye.
